patch_description: Add a global shared-edge tracker and a two-level candidate selection: among candidates with nearly-equal cost, prefer paths that reuse edges already selected for other destinations (maximizing shared multicast-style transfer segments) and have fewer hops (fewer paid edges). This reduces redundant transfers across destinations while keeping the bounded K_PATHS enumeration and the congestion-aware per-partition spreading. Reuse is applied via a small bonus that only breaks near-ties, so strictly cheaper paths still win.
